name: CookieYes
description: Manage cookie consent and compliance without leaving Claude. Privacy laws like GDPR and CCPA require websites to get visitor consent before using cookies. CookieYes is the consent management platform (CMP) that handles this for 1.5M+ websites. This connector puts it inside your chat. Check whether your cookie banner is live. Run a cookie scan to find every cookie and tracker on your site. Review your GDPR and CCPA compliance settings. Update your cookie banner in seconds. Typical requests: "Audit my site for GDPR compliance", "Is my cookie banner active?", "Run a cookie scan and show me what you find", "Check my CCPA opt-out setup". CookieYes supports GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, and Google Consent Mode v2. That means opt-in cookie consent for European laws, and opt-out with "Do Not Sell or Share" for US ones. Built for privacy and legal teams confirming compliance, marketers checking client sites, and developers managing cookie banners. The connector covers consent management, cookie scans, and compliance checks in plain conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CookieYes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CookieYes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.cookieyes.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CookieYes MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CookieYes provides these MCP tools: get_banner_status, get_compliance_status, get_embed_code, get_scan_results, get_website_details, list_banners, list_domains, trigger_cookie_scan, update_banner_colours, and update_banner_layout.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CookieYes?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CookieYes in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
CookieYes requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CookieYes is developed by CookieYes Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
